'''Phol''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Weavemaster Phol had a shop in the [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] market, where he sold synthetic fabrics and [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Phol was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. He appears in Anchorhead, the Republic-only city on Tatooine, as a Synthweaving Crew Skill Trainer.<ref name="TOR" />
